articles.title: China’s Molybdenum Imports Surge While Exports Nearly Halve?! [SMM Analysis]
articles.description: China’s molybdenum product imports rose 41.4% by physical volume in Jan–Sep 2026, but contained Mo increased only 9.9%, as low-grade materials accounted for 84% of the additional tonnage. Meanwhile, molybdenum oxide exports fell 46.6% and ferromolybdenum exports dropped 20.4%. High domestic costs and weak steel-mill tender prices may keep exports under pressure.......

articles.title: JAKSON Green E-Mobility Wins 220-Bus Tender in Gujarat Within First Year
articles.description: JAKSON Green E-Mobility has won the tender for 220 electric buses in Gujarat under the Government of India’s PM-eBus Sewa Programme. The order, secured within the company’s first year of operations, will expand its presence in India’s electric bus and commercial vehicle segment. articles.title: GeM Launches AABHAR Collection to Promote India's Regional Craft Hubs
articles.description: GeM has launched The AABHAR Collection, an online portal showcasing regional handicrafts and GI-tagged goods to boost local artisans and integrate indigenous craft heritage into the national public procurement and institutional gifting landscape.
